Notes: Project symbol adapted from official Seeed symbol for the 14 side pins. Official DIP footprint with unavailable 3D references removed. See hardware/Lichtreaktor/libraries/SOURCES.md.
Purchased mounting parts; already represented by the module DIP footprint, not additional schematic symbols. Rows 15.24mm apart. Check socket height and USB clearance before ordering.

Description: Male header fitted to XIAO module
Notes: Only needed if module does not already include soldered headers. Not an extra component in the carrier schematic.
Six groups of four parallel branches. Each LED has its own 220 ohm series resistor. Symbol pin 1=K (cathode); pin 2=A (anode).
One resistor per LED. Nominal estimate: (5V - 3.3V - 0.2V) / 220 ohm = 6.8mA. Actual current depends on LED and transistor. Select body approximately 6.3 x 2.5mm.

Description: NPN transistor switching one LED group to ground
Notes: Straight-lead BU package. Pin 1=collector; 2=base; 3=emitter. Use 470 ohm from GPIO to base and 100k from base to emitter. Do not substitute a transistor without checking pinout.
Limits GPIO current into transistor base. About (3.3V - 0.8V) / 470 ohm = 5.3mA per enabled group. Confirm GPIO drive configuration in firmware.
One between base and emitter of each transistor. Keeps LEDs off while GPIO is not driven during boot/reset.

Description: Rotary encoder with momentary push switch
Notes: 18 pulses; 36 detents; 20mm flat shaft. Encoder common and one switch contact to GND. A/B and other switch contact to GPIO with 3.3V pull-ups. Software debouncing required. Final dimensions must be compared with selected part drawing before PCB release.
Status: Design selection; mechanical check and price pending

Notes: One from each of encoder A/B and switch GPIO to 3V3. Never pull these GPIO signals up to 5V.
Between +5V and GND near LED supply distribution. Select 5mm lead pitch and body fitting this footprint. XIAO already has onboard regulator decoupling.
Round two-layer PCB; 90mm diameter (45mm radius). LED centre ring radius 38mm. Placement in progress; not routed or fabrication-ready. USB power through XIAO only; no battery or separate power input.
